label: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE - scripted mock outputs for a revision cycle, not model outputs or measurements

hypotheses.claim: Flushing the output file is not sufficient if the write itself can be torn by a crash; a partially written record can corrupt the index.
hypotheses.mechanism: A crash during a non-atomic write leaves a truncated final line.
hypotheses.falsifier: If crashes injected during the write never leave a truncated record, the hypothesis is false.

candidates.title: Make output durable (atomically) before advancing progress
candidates.procedure: For resumable work: (1) write the output for an item to a temporary file and atomically rename it into place (or use a transactional store); (2) only then advance the progress checkpoint; (3) make reprocessing an item idempotent so a crash between the steps is safe to retry.
prerequisites: atomic rename on the target filesystem
candidates.known_limits: Does not cover side effects that cannot be rolled back or deduplicated. Atomic rename semantics vary by filesystem.

1.title: Crash during record write
1.intervention: terminate the process mid-write, then restart
1.expected_invariant: the index never contains a truncated record
1.reference_impl: write temp file then os.replace (fixture text only)
1.faulty_impl: direct append without atomic replace (fixture text only)
1.oracle: parse every index line; require all records complete (fixture text only)
